'''Dolphie''' is a [[Water]] type [[Support]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Blubbles]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Dolphie loves chasing clouds on sunny days, skimming across the sea as the world brightens under sunlight. The sky's a perfect shade of blue today, and Dolphie's mood couldn't be better."

Dolphie is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A small, joyful blue dolphin with pink eyes and pink tail flukes. Its underbelly is white with pastel yellow and green accents.

Dolphie's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] form changes it from blue to light purple.

== Evolution Trial ==
Dolphie's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Blubbles]] you need to complete the following task:

* Purchase any 5 [[Decorations|buildings]]. Dolphie's in a great mood today!

== Trivia ==
* Dolphie was added to the game on 9/23/2026 alongside [[Thunderpaw]] and [[Cinderclaw]].
